operation: independent scoped semantic and browser review
input_policy: Only assigned product spec sections, project Design System and actual styles/runtime, final four artifacts, own browser evidence, git b82fa1e5 visual blobs. No author verdicts, previous semantic reports, quality-report or generated self-assessment README read.

actions.action: Read spec sections 13.9/13.10, Design System and shared stylesheet/header behavior.
Read current manifest scene and story inventory plus actual runtime and Assistant source; extracted historical HTML via git show solely for visual baseline.
17 representative scenes at 3 viewports plus 7 historical 1440 comparisons. Reran after parent final freeze.
Inspected listed screenshots for hierarchy, controls, surfaces, cards, dialogs and failure state visibility.
39 interaction observations. Responsive detail route investigated; list selection exposes detail at 800 and nested scrolling leaves header unmarked.
All 361 current scenes rendered nonempty through supported postMessage; opened 17 story last-step links.
Compared actual first MVP style block and all seven assistant base CSS files to git b82fa1e5; all byte-identical.

harness_issue.detail: One ad-hoc probe used .active for assistant, which uses a visible scene without that class; timed out. Replaced with [data-prototype-scene]:visible and completed interactions. This was a reviewer selector issue, not a product finding.
